Review (medium): treating an absent slot as the default merged runs whose first cell then forced 39 over a style a container lays beneath (Segment.applyStyle). Runs compare strictly again; the unshowable-move case is settled per cell in respec.

feat(progress): ProgressBar's pulse animates, as the library's shimmer (rich-effects-fxiy.3rg) (#340)

* feat(progress): ProgressBar's pulse animates, as the library's shimmer (rich-effects-fxiy.3rg)

`ProgressBar` stored `pulse` and nothing read it. `pulse` is now `{ t }`,
the moment to draw: the whole bar in its back style, lit along its length
by `shimmer` toward `bar.pulse`, through `Effected`. The bar has no
animation code of its own and reads no clock.

`BarColumn` pulses a task that is not started or has no total, as Rich's
does, at `Task.time`, the frame's moment on the `Progress` clock (Rich's
`Task.get_time()`). A task with no total no longer fills against an
assumed 100 and never finishes.

`ProgressBar`'s back style defaults to `bar.back`, as in Rich, instead of
no style. Light only lifts a colour, so it could barely move an unstyled
track drawn in the terminal's foreground.

Breaking: `ProgressBarOptions.pulse` is `{ t: number }`, not a boolean,
and `Task` has a required `time`.

* review(progress): pin the pulse's no-colour blank and the bar.back default; docs say what the shimmer's weather and refresh rate do (rich-effects-fxiy.3rg)

* fix(progress): the pulse lights the bar's line, never the ground behind it (rich-effects-fxiy.3rg)

* fix(progress): the pulse's glow resolves as drawn, like its ink; docs state the dark spells' length (rich-effects-fxiy.3rg)
